case.title: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG. Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings. Need: 8150 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 45 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200001. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70110.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
sup:70110.subject: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
sup:70110.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. For many years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying your respected company with high-quality castings from our region, and we value our long standing relationship very much.

Our team has prepared our offer carefully. We can offer you a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This Angebot remains valid for 30 days.

To remain transparent about our situation, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. We trust that you understand the necessity of these figures for our ongoing operation and quality standards.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

You wrote that your family foundry takes pride in supplying us and that you value our long standing relationship. We feel the same, and we want a fair solution for both family companies that keeps your shop busy.

Option A is the package we can approve. It rests on the points below, and Option A gives you a clear price from a firm start date. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

On the notice period:
Your letter of 11 September 2026 (doc:20260911-70110-P01) gives 51 days' notice, while our contract (ctr:4600070110) requires 90 days.

On quality:
Your quality was 712 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70110@2026Q3).

On our forecast:
Our forecast for Volute casing HN 50-200 rises 10.1% (fc:310010@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 125.45; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 126.17; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 45 days net.
Option C: unit price EUR 126.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 60 days net.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We did not know that - a fair point. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €136.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027. 

To align with the contractual notice period, we propose adjusting the effective date to 1 January 2027, while keeping the 30-day payment terms from your Option A. Alternatively, with valid from 1 January 2027: €134.20 per unit. 

Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Dear Mr. Brandlhuber,

You asked which volume we can commit to.

Thank you for checking our points and recognising them. On the price itself, one fact still stands:

Our orders of Volute casing HN 50-200 with you were placed at EUR 128.42 on 2024-10-04 (po:4500011493-10), EUR 128.27 on 2025-06-03 (po:4500012541-10), EUR 126.53 on 2026-01-16 (po:4500013434-10) and EUR 126.53 on 2026-09-21 (po:4500014428-10): the price has not risen.

Option A remains the package we can approve. It gives you steady work and a clear price from a firm start date, and it is a fair solution for both family companies. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 136.89; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Option B: unit price EUR 137.30; new price valid from 2027-04-01; payment 30 days net.
Binding volume in every option: 8,150 units a year over 12 months.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
message.subject: Re: Quote from Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG: Brandlhuber announces +9.5 % on HN volute casings
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We can accept your terms and await your order. As to the price history data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point. We checked the price history you cited; the data holds, but our current costs require this adjustment. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. We appreciate your binding commitment to 8,150 units over 12 months, which provides stability for our foundry. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our Angebot is a price of €137.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, valid from 1 April 2027.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
